name: team-standard
description: Team default: tester or cross review on every implementation task
instructions: Split work into reviewable tasks with explicit dependencies. Every implementation task needs an acceptance criterion that says how it is tested, and independent review or a tester task.

name: security-strict
description: Security-sensitive changes: tester coverage, threat notes and a rollback task
instructions: Never put secrets or exploit details for live systems into tasks or notes. Each task names the threat class it covers and has a negative test. The plan includes a rollback task. Tasks stay at size s or m.

name: oss-contribution
description: Public repository contributions: small pull requests with tests and docs
instructions: Keep pull requests small and focused. Bug fixes need a regression test. Breaking public API changes need maintainer approval before work starts.
